covers.desc: Be able to linearize an exponential model y = a*b^x by graphing log(y) against x, and recover a and b from the transformed slope and intercept.
Be able to linearize a power model y = a*x^b using a log-log transformation (log(y) against log(x)), and recover a and b from the transformed slope and intercept.
Be able to distinguish exponential from power relationships using scatterplot shape and residual patterns, and select the log(y)-vs-x or log(y)-vs-log(x) transformation that linearizes the data.
Be able to perform an exponential or power model log transformation in Python (e.g. with numpy), fit the transformed data, and back-transform to recover the original model.
